STRATEGY: The parent cooperates initially, probes once at round 10 by defecting, then cooperates at round 11 to test tolerance; if the opponent cooperates after the probe it enters exploit mode and defects every round until retaliation, otherwise it apologizes and reverts to cooperative/TFT-like play with endgame defection. The trace simulates this adaptive probing strategy against the described population slots (0,2,3,5,8,9,10,11) and computes expected scores. It changes the strategy from simple periodic defection to a probe-then-exploit-or-apologize scheme, and adjusts endgame defection timing based on whether the opponent has ever defected.
